status: ACTIVE — definition-first baseline registry for the Gate 2 evaluator spine
principle: Definition-first. A baseline may be used for an SW condition ONLY when its exact definition, unit, population, and period grain are compatible with that condition's computed metric. Never force a source onto an incompatible condition. Operational targets (Duane-supplied catalog thresholds) are labeled as such and are NEVER represented as industry benchmarks. Industry benchmark VALUES that are not independently verified in this repo are recorded with value=null and value_status=unverified so no fabricated number can enter an evaluation.

basis_kinds.operational_target: A Duane-supplied starter threshold from the catalog (threshold_provenance). Authoritative comparison basis for a rule-style condition. Not an industry benchmark.
basis_kinds.industry_benchmark: A published external benchmark. Usable for variance only when definition-compatible AND value is verified. Reference-only otherwise.

operational_targets.label: Lead-to-appointment set rate floor
operational_targets.definition: Appointments set in period / leads in period, store aggregate (Dealership Performance Dashboard summary TOTAL row).

operational_targets.label: Appointment show rate floor
operational_targets.definition: Appointments with Is Show=Yes / total appointment rows in period (Appointments weekly report). Matches RATIFIED SW-032 (appt.show_rate).
operational_targets.source: Duane-supplied starter condition (catalog threshold_provenance); ratified in R2 accepted-facts

operational_targets.label: Appointment no-show rate ceiling
operational_targets.definition: Appointments with Is No Show=Yes / total appointment rows in period (Appointments weekly report). Matches RATIFIED SW-041 (appt.no_show_rate).
operational_targets.source: Duane-supplied starter condition (catalog threshold_provenance); ratified in R2 accepted-facts

industry_benchmarks.title: 2026 Automotive Dealer Benchmarks Report
industry_benchmarks.population: US franchise + independent dealers; Sales-only filtering per publisher
industry_benchmarks.exact_definition: Publisher-defined dealership benchmark set (lead handling, appointment, close).
industry_benchmarks.compatibility_constraints: Definitions must be matched per-metric before use. Not yet mapped to any SW condition.

industry_benchmarks.title: Q1 2026 dealership close-rate / funnel study
industry_benchmarks.exact_definition: Lead-to-sale close rates by metro / funnel stage.
industry_benchmarks.compatibility_constraints: Close-rate denominator (leads) definition must match; our held families do not yet provide a period-comparable lead-to-sale close rate. Not mapped.

industry_benchmarks.title: Dealership appointment-set rates by lead type
industry_benchmarks.exact_definition: Appointment-set rate segmented BY LEAD TYPE.
industry_benchmarks.compatibility_constraints: Segmented BY LEAD TYPE; SW-031 as computed is a STORE-AGGREGATE set rate. Denominator basis differs → reference-only, NOT a variance basis for SW-031.

industry_benchmarks.title: 2026 Internet Lead Effectiveness (ILE) study
industry_benchmarks.compatibility_constraints: Response-effectiveness composite; our Dashboard exposes an AVERAGE (not median) response time and no business-hours filter → incompatible with SW-011 (median, business hours). Not mapped.

industry_benchmarks.title: NADA Data 2025 — annual financial profile of America's franchised new-car dealerships
industry_benchmarks.compatibility_constraints: Annual national aggregate; not period-compatible with a single dealer-week. Reference-only.
